In our community, fishing nets are often damaged during the fishing season, which can leave the local fishermen struggling to catch their catch. To address this, we have organized regular mending sessions where community members come together to repair and reinforce nets. These efforts not only help in saving the nets but also strengthen the bonds among neighbors. The shared tools and knowledge ensure that the mending process is efficient and sustainable.  

**P.P.S. Do not forget the shared tools.**
